name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm. He transitioned from agricultural machinery to racing karts in his late teens, quickly developing an aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics and mechanical intricacies. While his driving aspirations faded, his passion for the technical side only intensified. He pursued a degree in engineering, focusing on motorsport applications, and landed his first role at a small racing team in New Zealand.

He steadily climbed the ranks, demonstrating a knack for optimizing operational efficiency and bridging the gap between technical teams and management. Alistair joined Toyota Gazoo Racing BR five years ago, initially as a junior operations manager, and rapidly proved his worth. His blend of technical understanding and people skills makes him an ideal head of operations. He prioritizes clear communication, data-driven decision-making, and fostering a collaborative environment. Alistair is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his uncanny ability to foresee potential logistical challenges, ensuring the team is always well-prepared.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting a life spent both in the office and occasionally under the hood.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even to meetings.
Has a whiteboard in his office covered in logistical flowcharts that he constantly updates.
Refuses to drink coffee after 2 PM, claiming it interferes with his focus.
